findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search_jobs" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Search HeadStart's tech job index: `query` describes only the role ('backend engineer at a climate startup'); years, pay, place, company, employment type and da…

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hiring_now · Public sink: get_job, hiring_now, company_profile, role_requirements · Destructive: search_jobs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hiring_now · Public sink: get_job, hiring_now, company_profile, role_requirements · Destructive: search_jobs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
